153:t_1:5.en:
$$大統領$$
「Unfortunately, our request for a meeting was rejected. It seems the $$新地球皇国$$ side has no intention of sitting down at the table with us.」

153:t_1:6.en:
$$カガリ$$
「Do they intend to keep fighting until they have wiped out all of our forces...?」

153:t_1:7.en:
$$大統領$$
「Reports from various quarters say the Empire's purpose in invading is to extract the energy the Earth holds.」

153:t_1:8.en:
$$大統領$$
「They also say that, as a result, the Earth could collapse.」

153:t_1:10.en:
$$大統領$$
「I believe fighting is the only option.」

153:t_1:12.en:
$$大統領$$
「Representative $$アスハ$$... Right now, $$オーブ$$ is host to people who could be called the conscience of the Earth.」

153:t_1:13.en:
$$大統領$$
「Leave the fighting to me and the Federation military, and think about the world that comes after.」

153:t_1:15.en:
$$大統領$$
「Without hope for the future, we cannot get through the present. You are to become that hope.」

153:t_1:17.en:
$$大統領$$
「That is why we cannot let the Empire learn where you are. From now on, I will keep contact to a minimum as well.」

153:t_1:18.en:
$$大統領$$
「$$カガリ$$... The next time we meet, I would like to talk about peace at leisure with you, Princess $$マリナ$$ and the others.」

153:t_1:19.en:
$$カガリ$$
「I believe that day will come...」

153:t_1:20.en:
$$大統領$$
「So do I. ...Well then... I wish us both the best of luck.」

153:t_1:24.en:
$$キサカ$$
「They are coming after shaking off the Empire's pursuers, so I expect it will be some time yet before they reach us.」

153:t_1:25.en:
$$カガリ$$
「$c is our hope for overthrowing the Empire. We have to protect them at all costs...」

153:t_1:27.en:
$$キサカ$$
「An executive from $$アナハイム$$ is requesting contact with us.」

153:t_1:32.en: ～ $$オーブ$$ Union Official Residence, Conference Room ～

153:t_1:33.en:
$$マーサ$$
「...Nice to meet you, Representative $$カガリ・ユラ・アスハ$$. I am $$マーサ・ビスト・カーバイン$$.」

153:t_1:34.en:
$$カガリ$$
「I have heard of you for some time. ...So, what business brings you here today?」

153:t_1:35.en:
$$マーサ$$
「Let me be direct. I would like you to hand $$ミネバ・ラオ・ザビ$$ over to us.」

153:t_1:37.en:
$$マーサ$$
「There is no need to hide it any longer, Representative. I know she is taking shelter here, together with Princess $$マリナ$$ and Vice Foreign Minister $$ドーリアン$$ and the others.」

153:t_1:39.en:
$$マーサ$$
「Those in the trade know the ways of the trade... We have a suitable intelligence network of our own, after all.」

153:t_1:40.en:
$$カガリ$$
「Congressman $$ローナン・マーセナス$$, then...」

153:t_1:41.en:
$$マーサ$$
「Heh heh... Please, don't show your hostility so openly. I feel a kinship with you, Representative.」

153:t_1:43.en:
$$マーサ$$
「Representative $$カガリ・ユラ・アスハ$$... You succeeded your father, $$ウズミ・ナラ・アスハ$$, and serve as Representative of this $$オーブ$$ Union...」

153:t_1:44.en:
$$マーサ$$
「I sympathize with how steep that road must be.」

153:t_1:45.en:
$$カガリ$$
「I do this because I want to.」

153:t_1:46.en:
$$マーサ$$
「It's all right, Representative. I understand that you, too, are one of the victims of a world ruled by men's logic.」

153:t_1:48.en:
$$マーサ$$
「Yes... You and I are the same.」

153:t_1:53.en: ～ Inside the $$オーブ$$ Union Official Residence ～

153:t_1:56.en:
$$ミネバ$$
「Thank you for your concern, $$マリナ$$. But I am all right.」

153:t_1:57.en:
$$マリナ$$
「$$マーサ・ビスト・カーバイン$$... Do you know her?」

153:t_1:58.en:
$$ミネバ$$
「Yes... I met her when I was in North America.」

153:t_1:59.en:
$$リリーナ$$
「I have met her once myself, on an unofficial occasion, but she is a strong person.」

153:t_1:60.en:
$$リリーナ$$
「In both the good sense and the bad.」

153:t_1:62.en:
$$ナナリー$$
「But her strength is dangerous. Trying to settle everything by force also means craving an even greater force.」

153:t_1:66.en:
$$ミネバ$$
「By securing the Box, she is probably trying to gain an even greater power.」

153:t_1:67.en:
$$マリナ$$
「I heard from $$ミネバ$$ that it holds enough power to shake the $$地球連邦$$ of one of the worlds that made up the $$ＵＣＷ$$.」

153:t_1:68.en:
$$ナナリー$$
「But that story concerns only one world... What meaning does it have now, in this multiverse?」

153:t_1:69.en:
$$ミネバ$$
「Not knowing what the Box truly is, I cannot even guess. But I do have an idea of what it means.」

153:t_1:71.en:
$$ミネバ$$
「It is those known as $$クロノ$$, who exist in both the $$ＵＣＷ$$ and the $$ＡＤＷ$$ and are said to have manipulated history from the shadows.」

153:t_1:72.en:
$$ミネバ$$
「I hear that protecting $$ラプラスの箱$$ is their doctrine.」

153:t_1:73.en:
$$リリーナ$$
「The people of the $$ＡＤＷ$$ are trying to protect the Box that existed in the $$ＵＣＷ$$, too...」

153:t_1:74.en:
$$ミネバ$$
「Furthermore, $$クロノ$$ was connected to $$ジェミニス$$, the mastermind behind the $$時獄戦役$$.」

153:t_1:76.en:
$$ミネバ$$
「By securing $$ラプラスの箱$$, they probably aim to curry favor with $$クロノ$$... and by extension, with the $$サイデリアル$$.」

153:t_1:77.en:
$$ミネバ$$
「Whether that is the will of $$アナハイム・エレクトロニクス$$ as a whole, or the personal decision of $$マーサ・ビスト・カーバイン$$, I do not know, but...」

153:t_1:79.en:
$$リリーナ$$
「Not fighting and peace only look alike. Submitting to an invader... worse, for selfish self-preservation... is the same as betraying the people.」

153:t_1:80.en:
$$ナナリー$$
「I agree with Vice Foreign Minister $$リリーナ$$. I cannot overlook an act that endangers so many people for the sake of personal gain.」

153:t_1:81.en:
$$ミネバ$$
「What do you think, $$マリナ$$?」

153:t_1:83.en:
$$マリナ$$
「But I have no intention of denying even the will of those who fight to protect what is precious to them.」

153:t_1:84.en:
$$ミネバ$$
「Thank you, $$マリナ$$. And you too, Vice Foreign Minister $$リリーナ$$ and Vice Foreign Minister $$ナナリー$$.」

153:t_1:85.en:
$$ミネバ$$
「I will never forget the short time I spent here in $$オーブ$$.」

153:t_1:87.en:
$$ミネバ$$
「$$ネオ・ジオン$$ is also seeking $$ラプラスの箱$$. And I hear they have already joined hands with the Empire.」

153:t_1:88.en:
$$ミネバ$$
「I cannot hand $$ラプラスの箱$$ over to either $$アナハイム$$ or $$ネオ・ジオン$$. It is for the sake of protecting human dignity, too.」
